speaker: Barista
text: Good morning! Welcome to the coffee shop. What can I get for you today?

speaker: Customer
text: Good morning. I would like a cappuccino, please.

speaker: Barista
text: Of course. Would you like a small, medium, or large?

speaker: Customer
text: A medium, please. And could I have it with oat milk?

speaker: Barista
text: Absolutely. Would you like anything to eat? We have fresh pastries.

speaker: Customer
text: A chocolate croissant would be lovely.

speaker: Barista
text: Great choice. Is that for here or to go?

speaker: Customer
text: For here, please. I would like to sit by the window.

speaker: Barista
text: That will be seven dollars and fifty cents.

speaker: Customer
text: Here you are. Thank you very much!

speaker: Barista
text: You are welcome. Your order will be ready in a moment. Enjoy your morning!
